summary: Master strategic HR in hospitality. Learn workforce planning, labor productivity, and service culture to drive hotel profitability. Enroll today.
lede: Strategic Human Resource Management in Hospitality aligns recruitment, development, performance, and retention with the operational realities of service businesses. This course helps you connect workforce decisions to guest satisfaction, operational efficiency, and measurable business performance across hotels, resorts, and food service environments. You will build practical skills in workforce forecasting, labor turnover analysis, digital HRIS integration, cross-cultural leadership, and talent retention. Through tools such as the Balanced Scorecard for Hospitality and ISO 30414 guidelines, you will turn workforce data into stronger recruitment funnels, service-focused incentives, performance systems, and succession plans.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for the intersection of people and performance within the global hospitality and tourism sectors.
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in a human resources or hospitality management role. Familiarity with basic HR functions such as recruitment and payroll is required. Pre-reading on the Service-Profit Chain and Harvard Model of HRM is recommended to maximize the value of the strategic discussions.
